subject: Science
topicName: Chemistry - Lesson 7: Writing Chemical Equations: Word Form and Formula Form
description: Translate chemical reactions from word equations into formula equations by identifying reactants, products, the meaning of the arrow, coefficients, and subscripts.
learningObjectives: Write a chemical reaction in word equation form using reactant and product names
Translate a word equation into formula form using correct chemical symbols and formulas
Identify reactants, products, and the meaning of the reaction arrow
Distinguish coefficients from subscripts in chemical formulas and equations
Explain why subscripts should not be changed when writing a correct formula equation
prerequisites: Recognizing common element symbols such as H, O, C, Mg, and Na
Understanding that atoms and molecules make up substances
Knowing that compounds have fixed chemical formulas
Basic familiarity with chemical reactions forming new substances
Recall from Grade 9 bonding that subscripts show atoms within one particle of a substance
